layers.name: UI Components
layers.description: Reusable UI component library built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS.

layers.name: State Management
layers.description: React contexts, providers, and custom hooks.

layers.name: Core Library
layers.description: Shared utilities: Supabase client, HTTP client, utils.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The application boots from src/main.jsx which renders the React app into index.html. Vite is configured via vite.config.js with React plugin and Tailwind CSS. The main App.jsx defines all routes using React Router.

tour.title: UI Component Library
tour.description: A set of reusable UI components built on Radix UI primitives with Tailwind CSS styling. Includes Button, Card, Input, Label, Tabs, NavigationMenu, Resizable panels, and Textarea. The clsx+tailwind-merge utility in src/utils/utils.js enables conditional class composition.

tour.title: Authentication System
tour.description: Handles user sign-up, login, and account management. The auth API module communicates with Supabase, while the useAuth hook provides auth state to the component tree. Pages include LoginPage, SignUpPage, and UserAccount.

tour.title: Product Catalog & Search
tour.description: The core e-commerce feature. ProductCatalog.jsx provides the main catalog with category filtering, spec table, pagination, and compare functionality. SearchPopover offers quick product search. CategoryPage and ProductDetail show individual items.

tour.title: Product Comparison
tour.description: ComparePage enables side-by-side comparison of up to 4 products. It reads IDs from URL params, fetches product data, and renders spec tables with diff highlighting. Products are selected via checkboxes in the catalog table.

tour.title: Shopping Cart & Checkout
tour.description: CartContext manages cart state globally. ShoppingCart displays items, Checkout collects shipping/payment info, PaymentPage handles payment, and OrderConfirmation shows the result. Order API handles server-side order management.

tour.title: PC Builder
tour.description: An interactive PC builder that lets users select compatible components. BuildContext manages the build state. PCBuildPage shows the current build with compatibility checks, and ChooseComponent lets users browse and select components.

tour.title: Admin Dashboard
tour.description: Admin panel for product and order management. ProtectedRoute handles admin authentication. AdminLayout provides navigation. ProductManagement lets CRUD operations on products. AdminOrders shows orders with status management.

tour.title: Header & Footer
tour.description: Global navigation and site footer shared across all pages. Header includes the PC Builder link, cart with item count, and search popover. Footer provides links and site information.

tour.title: Database Migrations
tour.description: Supabase SQL migrations for all database entities: users, products, builds, cart, orders, stock management, RLS policies, and admin functions. The migrations establish the complete data schema.
